lines: By this the to-be-covered goes into another's power,
facing first; afterwards the whole is brought,
if — or even from the path's middle, as he wishes.
l4.sanskrit_cite: etenācchādanīyaṃ vrajati paravaśaṃ saṃmukhīnatvam ādau paścād ānīyate cet sakalam atha tato 'py adhvamadhyād yatheṣṭam
